slug: 2024-01-01 Building a National Identification System - Scanning and Digitizing the Civil Registry Books in Guinea-Bissau

facts.fact: A UNDP project with Swiss co-financing is developing complete software to digitize the civil registry (births, deaths, marriages and annotations) as the main national platform, and setting up a digitization centre for the paper registry books, with the Ministry of Justice and Human Rights as beneficiary.

systems.system: civil registry digitization software (UNDP Building National ID project)
systems.owner: Ministry of Justice and Human Rights
